info.title: Astro Boy (1980)
info.synopsis: Remake della serie del 1963. A.D. 2030: nella megalopoli di Tokyo, Astroboy, creato dal Ministro della Scienza dottor Tenma, combatte in nome della giustizia contro Atlas, un super androide munito del "Fattore Omega", un circuito che riflette in lui il lato oscuro dell'animo umano. Atlas, che ha portato il suo creatore, il barone Walpul Giss, alla rovina, sviluppa le sue capacità diventando un potente robot, costruendo poi una base chiamata "Crystal" e sfidando Astroboy a duello.

episodes.title: La nascita di Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: The "Birth of Astro Boy" is the start of electrifying entertainment for many future episodes. Before young Toby dies after a car accident he tells his father to build a robot just like him and to love him. Astro Boy is born and struggles to get used to his powers. He can fly and has strengths which get him in trouble with his father and those around him.

episodes.title: The Robot Circus
episodes.synopsis: After Astro Boy thinks he's disowned by his father he puts his trust into an owner of a circus who wants to exploit Astro Boy's robotic abilities.

episodes.title: Saving Our Classmate
episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy goes to school to try to fit in as a normal being, but he meets with the opposition of his classmates who want robots out of the school. Astro Boy shows his superior powers and kicks butt in this full-color episode.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas II: The Resurrection of Atlas
episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy has a strange feeling before bad things happen. His robot parents are taken and he's out to rescue his parents. He takes on his nemesis Atlas who is bent on taking revenge on humanity.

episodes.title: Robot Island
episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy saves the day again in this action-​packed full-​color story. Astro flies to the protection of another robot, an escapee from the evil Robot Land. But the other denizens of Robot Land aren't going to let this happen without a fight.

episodes.title: Frankenstein
episodes.synopsis: A "Frankenstein" robot-monster is created at the Ministry of Science, and the monster unwittingly becomes a thief.

episodes.title: Red Cat
episodes.synopsis: Thirteen Thirteenth Street is a spooky old haunted house that is the setting for Astro Boy's exciting adventure. Dr. Leopold and his cat are the only ones who live there. When five boys disappear there, Daddy Walrus and Astro go to find them. They're all right, but as soon as they are freed, all the animals start running wild. Are they rebelling for being kept in cages?

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas III: Crystal of the Desert
episodes.synopsis: Astro investigates a drought, only to run into his arch-nemesis, Atlas!

episodes.title: The Vehicle, White Planet
episodes.synopsis: Astro helps his friend Konrad in a rocket-car race, even as Skunk runs interference.

episodes.title: The Robot President
episodes.synopsis: Guravia has just elected a robot President, Rag, but he needs Astro's help to take the post.

episodes.title: Damdam`s Neck
episodes.synopsis: Astro and Skunk race to find the head of a Mars development robot, Damdam.

episodes.title: Il robot invisibile
episodes.synopsis: A special Christmas eve contest looks to elect the best Robot of the year, with Skunk as the figurative Grinch.

episodes.title: Tomboy Uran
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Elefun has a special surprise for Astro - a sister named Uran, who can't seem to stay out of trouble.

episodes.title: Robio and Robiet
episodes.synopsis: Robio of the Globes and Robiet of the Chariots fall in love, against the wishes of their families and its up to Astro to prevent a tragic finale.

episodes.title: Adventure on Mars
episodes.synopsis: Astro leads a mission to Mars but learns of a secret Alien plot to control Mars, and eventually Earth.

episodes.title: SOS on the Space Shuttle
episodes.synopsis: Astro and his friend Gen try to prevent Skunk from hijacking a cargo ship, the Carolina 3.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas IV: The Menacing Comet
episodes.synopsis: A field trip by Daddy Walrus goes bad when Atlas kidnaps the whole class to make Astro work with him.

episodes.title: The Devil`s Balloon
episodes.synopsis: Astro suddenly becomes a public enemy when balloons that look like him, and carrying bombs, appear over the city.

episodes.title: Pook in Cruciform Island
episodes.synopsis: Astro meets Pook, a shape-shifter who has unwittingly helped a gang of thieves.

episodes.title: The Fool Ivan
episodes.synopsis: The maiden voyage of the Titan meets with disaster, in the form of a hail of meteorites.

episodes.title: The Robot Who Lied
episodes.synopsis: The story of True, the robot who cried 'earthquake.'

episodes.title: The Girl from Alsore
episodes.synopsis: A ski trip is cut short by an invading alien force.

episodes.title: The Biggest Robot on Earth Part 1
episodes.synopsis: Pruto is out to prove that he is more powerful than Astro.

episodes.title: The Biggest Robot on Earth Part 2
episodes.synopsis: Pruto continues on his rampage and only Astro can stop him.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas V: The Violent Gang Gadem
episodes.synopsis: The Vikings terrorize the city and Astro must go undercover to find them.

episodes.title: Major Operations by Black Jack
episodes.synopsis: Astro travels through time to save a 15th century Prince.

episodes.title: The Great Adventure of Little Robot Sam
episodes.synopsis: Uran yearns to meet the movie-star Tom Stanton and finds that the real star is his stunt double, Sam.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas VI: The King of the Ice
episodes.synopsis: Astro helps Livian as she brings news of the melting polar icebergs.

episodes.title: Uran and Uran
episodes.synopsis: Uran gets a twin as she is unable to live up to the expectations of her parents.

episodes.title: Dash in a Storm
episodes.synopsis: An old D51 steam engine must weather the storm to save Astro and his classmates.

episodes.title: Cleopatra`s Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Astro travels back in time and Julius Caesar entrusts him with Cleopatra's royal staff.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas VII: The Runaway Subway
episodes.synopsis: An out of control subway train is Astro's newest ploy to draw Astro out.

episodes.title: The Little Elephant Pura
episodes.synopsis: A real elephant and cub wander into a robot safari and its up to Astro to save them from Zohra.

episodes.title: The Secret of Bee Island
episodes.synopsis: Astro and Uran visit Bee Island and uncover a new mystery.

episodes.title: The Monster of Kuraken
episodes.synopsis: Astro and friends try to save the Golden Coral Forest and run into a hunter and a monster.

episodes.title: Rumy in Pochom-pochom Island
episodes.synopsis: Astro goes in search of the writer of many messages in bottles.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas VIII: The Destruction of the Satellite & the Proton Gun
episodes.synopsis: The most powerful weapon on Earth becomes the target of some of Astro's foes.

episodes.title: The Stolen Sun
episodes.synopsis: One of Dr. Elefun's old inventions is in the wrong hands and Astro and Shalock Holmespan must find it.

episodes.title: Black Looks
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Elefun reassembles a dismembered robot which leads to a new quest.

episodes.title: The Devil Garon
episodes.synopsis: A powerful new invader from space threatens the Earth and its up to Astro and Dr. Elefun to save the day.

episodes.title: Hurry, You Three Second-Rate Knights!
episodes.synopsis: Three obsolete robots fight for a new purpose, with the help of Astro.

episodes.title: Astro Boy vs. Atlas IX: Atlas Forever
episodes.synopsis: Atlas attacks space stations near Saturn and Jupiter, prompting an all-out attack by Earth's forces.

episodes.title: Space Leopard
episodes.synopsis: Snow in the summer is a portent of a new alien threat.

episodes.title: Uran`s God
episodes.synopsis: Uran goes on the ultimate quest - for God!

episodes.title: Space Airport R45
episodes.synopsis: Astro goes in search of space pirates.

episodes.title: Spaceship in Imminent Danger
episodes.synopsis: Astro is powerless for a day, just as a hijacker takes over a luxury airship.

episodes.title: Jinmen Iwa
episodes.synopsis: Daddy Walrus takes the class to see a mysterious face in a rock, and the legend behind it.

episodes.title: Uran Loves Hit Men
episodes.synopsis: Uran and Astro both want to get rid of an unwanted robot.

episodes.title: The Devil`s Place in Ordin
episodes.synopsis: Astro travels to the land of the Vikings with Dr. Elefun.

episodes.title: Rage of the Sphinx
episodes.synopsis: Astro explores a Mayan pyramid and finds a new mystery.

episodes.title: Astro Boy`s First Love
episodes.synopsis: Astro falls for Nikki (Nuka), his partner as they search for some stolen plans.

related.title: Astro Boy: Tetsuwan Atom
related.plot: Atom è un ragazzo robot dotato di poteri sovrumani e di un sistema di intelligenza artificiale senza pari tra i robot. Il suo creatore, il dottor Tenma, lo ha costruito per sostituire il figlio scomparso, Tobio. Poco dopo la creazione di Atom, il dottor Tenma distrugge il suo laboratorio e disattiva Atom. In seguito, il dottor Ochanomizu, capo del Ministero della Scienza, riattiva Atom e cerca di offrirgli una vita normale come studente di sesta elementare, mentre allo stesso tempo aiuta la polizia a fermare robot ribelli e umani pieni di pregiudizi che causano danni. Atom affronta un razzismo estremo per il fatto di essere un robot e deve scoprire la verità sul suo creatore, il dottor Tenma.
La storia di ciò che è accaduto prima della nascita di Astro Boy.
